business_summary: SAMSUNG PHARM. Co., LTD. manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in South Korea. It offers prescription medicines, such as anticancer immunotherapy, antipyretic analgestic and antiinflammatory, antiobesity, hypotensive, antiarteriosclerotic, digestive organs, antophlegms, enzymes, ostepoposis, and transfusion agents, as well as skeletal muscle relaxants, anti-spastic, enzyme, mixed vitamins, antibiotics, and others. The company also provides medicines for the digestive system, medicines for liver disorders, medicines for the circulation system, cold medicines, nutritional supplements, health tonics, antophlegm agents, and others, as well as quasi-medicines, cold medicines, vitamins and energy drinks, and functional foods. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Hwaseong-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 삼성제약. 주식회사 한국에서 의약품을 제조 및 판매하는 회사입니다. 면역항암제, 해열진통제, 항염증제, 항비만제, 저혈압제, 항동맥경화제, 소화기제, 안구경화제, 효소제, 골다공증제, 수혈제 등의 전문의약품과 골격근이완제, 항경련제, 효소, 혼합비타민제, 항생제 등을 취급하고 있습니다. 그 밖에도 소화기약, 간장약, 순환기치료제, 감기약, 영양보충제, 건강강장제, 구취제 등을 비롯하여 의약외품, 감기약, 비타민 및 에너지드링크, 기능성식품 등도 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1929년에 설립되었으며 본사는 대한민국 화성에 위치하고 있습니다.
